results.title: Round the Island Race 2026
results.content: The Round the Island Race returns on 2026-06-20 with over 1,500 boats expected. Registration opens in March. The race circumnavigates the Isle of Wight.

results.title: Cowes Week Schedule
results.content: Cowes Week runs from August 1 to August 8. The event on January 15, 2026 is the early-bird registration deadline for this premier sailing regatta.

results.title: Mediterranean Sailing Festival
results.content: A week-long celebration of sailing culture in the Mediterranean. Activities include races, workshops, and boat shows. No specific dates announced yet.

results.title: Sydney to Hobart Dec 26, 2026
results.content: The iconic Sydney to Hobart yacht race starts every year on Boxing Day. Crews prepare months in advance for this grueling ocean race.

results.title: Volvo Ocean Race Update
results.content: The Volvo Ocean Race 2026-2027 edition will visit 10 ports across 6 continents. Leg 1 departs Alicante on 2026-10-15T14:00.
